comments.author: @RemoteEarthJourneys
comments.text: Scotland looks absolutely unreal, but what really got me wasn’t just the scenery—it was seeing how people actually live and work in these remote coastal communities. Fishing boats, narrow roads, stone houses, unpredictable weather… life here seems beautiful, but definitely not easy. If you had the chance to live in a place like this for a year, would you do it? What would be the hardest adjustment for you—the weather, isolation, or slower pace of life?
